repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 無正向機轉支持。Azithromycin 已知副作用包括胰臟炎，可引起血清澱粉酶升高，屬致病因子而非治療藥物。TxGNN 高分可能源於知識圖譜中藥物–疾病共現噪訊，為假陽性預測。
Polyclonal hyperviscosity 主要由免疫球蛋白大量增生所致（如 IgM 型），其病因為漿細胞異常增殖或慢性炎症。Azithromycin 之抗生素與免疫調節機轉對血液黏稠度無直接調控路徑可循。
先天性無白蛋白血症為 ALB 基因突變導致的超稀有遺傳病，無法由抗生素或免疫調節藥物修正。Azithromycin 對白蛋白合成無已知影響路徑。

literature.title: Dual Molecular Diagnosis of Microsporidia (Encephalitozoon hellem) Keratoconjunctivitis in an Immunocompetent Adult.
literature.abstract: To report a case of microsporidia (Encephalitozoon hellem) keratoconjunctivitis acquired through avian transmission in an immunocompetent adult, diagnosed by metagenomic deep sequencing (MDS), and confirmed by polymerase chain reaction.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Punctate epithelial keratoconjunctivitis（點狀上皮角膜結膜炎）可由微孢子蟲（Microsporidia）感染引起，尤其在免疫抑制患者中。Azithromycin 對 Encephalitozoon 屬具有體外抗微孢子蟲活性，已見於臨床個案報告。此外，azithromycin 的抗炎與黏膜免疫調節機轉亦可能緩解眼表炎症反應。
血型不相容（ABO/Rh 溶血反應）屬免疫介導之同種異體反應，核心機轉為抗原–抗體補體活化，Azithromycin 對此無已知干預路徑。
預惡性血液疾病（如 MDS、MGUS）之病程主要由克隆演化驅動。雖然巨環類抗生素具免疫調節功能，但對克隆造血無直接抑制證據。此預測可能源於 Azithromycin 在 MGUS/MM 相關文獻中的共現，而非直接治療關聯。

literature.title: Subcorneal pustular dermatosis: 50 years on.
literature.abstract: We review the key developments in our understanding of subcorneal pustular dermatosis (SCPD, also known as Sneddon-Wilkinson disease) over the past 50 years. SCPD is a rare, chronic, sterile pustular eruption that was first described by Sneddon and Wilkinson in 1956. The primary lesions are pea-sized pustules classically described as half-pustular, half-clear flaccid fluid blisters. literature.title: Bartonella henselae Neuroretinitis: A Rare Coinfection in POEMS Syndrome.
authors: Ab Kahar Mas Edi Putriku Intan
literature.abstract: Bartonella henselae is a recognized cause of neuroretinitis in cat scratch disease. Meanwhile, polyneuropathy, organomegaly, endocrinopathy, monoclonal gammopathy, skin changes (POEMS) syndrome with Castleman disease (evidence of lymph node hyperplasia), is a chronic debilitating condition that predisposes to various superimposed infections. B. henselae neuroretinitis implicated in POEMS syndrome has not been reported previously. A 34-year-old asymptomatic man was referred for an eye assessment.

literature.title: Treatment of osteonecrosis of the jaw (ONJ) by medical ozone gas insufflation. A case report.
literature.abstract: Osteonecrosis of the jaw (ONJ) is an adverse event reported in patients receiving cancer treatment, especially bisphosphonates and denosumab. A patient with multiple myeloma who underwent up to 22 intravenous zoledronic acid infusions without previous dental examination developed a devastating ONJ lesion in the right horizontal mandibular ramus. literature.title: Multiple myeloma in remission complicated by bone marrow granulomas.
literature.journal: Romanian journal of internal medicine = Revue roumaine de medecine interne
literature.abstract: Granulomas are encountered in 1-2% of biopsies performed in various hematological and non-hematological diseases. Almost 50% of bone marrow granulomas are associated with infections and 25% with hematologic disorders, especially lymphoma and multiple myeloma. Toxoplasmosis is reported to induce granulomas in bone marrow inmunosuppressed patients. On the other side, long-term unexplained remissions after conventional treatment in multiple myeloma were mentioned in up to 10% of cases.

literature.title: Community-acquired lung abscess caused by Legionella micdadei in a myeloma patient receiving thalidomide treatment.
literature.abstract: Legionella infection causes 2 to 14% of community-acquired pneumonia (CAP). Legionella micdadei constitutes <1% of these infections. We describe a case of cavitary L. micdadei CAP in a myeloma patient receiving thalidomide treatment. The importance of considering pneumonia and problems in diagnosing pneumonia caused by L. micdadei in this patient population are reviewed.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 關鍵機轉連結來自 PMID 23546223：巨環類抗生素（包括 Azithromycin）可阻斷自噬通量（autophagy flux）並誘導內質網壓力（ER stress），使骨髓瘤細胞對蛋白酶體抑制劑（Bortezomib）的敏感性增加。此協同效應提示 Azithromycin 可作為多發性骨髓瘤聯合治療之增敏劑，而非單藥治療。其餘 6 篇文獻主要涉及 MGUS/MM 患者的感染併發症（Bartonella、Legionella），Azithromycin 用於抗感染，不構成對 MGUS 本身的治療證據。

literature.title: Biomedical Response to Neisseria gonorrhoeae and Other Sexually Transmitted Infections in the US Military.
literature.abstract: Sexually transmitted infections (STIs) continue to plague militaries and defense forces. While the historical recognition of the impact of STIs on operations is evident, contemporary surveillance and research activities are limited. As Neisseria gonorrhoeae and other sexually transmitted pathogens become increasingly resistant to antibiotics, the role of the Department of Defense (DoD) in disease surveillance and clinical research is essential to military Force Health Protection.

literature.abstract: Travellers' diarrhoea is the most common medical complaint among persons venturing into developing areas from industrialized regions.

literature.title: In vitro antimicrobial susceptibilities of strains of Yersinia pestis.
literature.abstract: The in vitro activities of 14 antimicrobial agents were determined for 78 strains of Yersinia pestis. The most active antibiotics were ceftriaxone and ciprofloxacin, followed by ofloxacin and ampicillin. The agents traditionally used for the treatment of plague (streptomycin, tetracycline, and chloramphenicol) were considerably less active. Azithromycin showed poor activity against all strains.

literature.title: [Efficacy of some new antibiotics in treating experimental brucellosis].
literature.journal: Antibiotiki i khimioterapiia = Antibiotics and chemoterapy [sic]
literature.abstract: Brucella pathogens are highly susceptible in vitro to pefloxacin, lomefloxacin, meropenem and azithromycin. High efficacy of these drugs was demonstrated for experimental brucellosis treatment, azithromycin being the most active. Meropenem and azithromycin implementation resulted in more rapid and full normalization of the bactericidial and energy systems of the experimental animals peripheral blood cells.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 敗血性鼠疫由 Yersinia pestis 引起。PMID 8540736 展示 Azithromycin 對 Y. pestis 的體外抗菌活性（MIC 資料）。巨環類抗生素的細胞內濃縮特性（組織藥物濃度可達血清 10–100 倍）理論上有利於殺滅已被吞噬的 Y. pestis。然而，鼠疫現行標準治療為 Streptomycin、Gentamicin 或 Doxycycline，Azithromycin 定位為替代選項（如對標準藥物不耐受或短缺情境）。

clinical_trials.title: Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics, and Safety Profile of Understudied Drugs
clinical_trials.brief_summary: The study investigators are interested in learning more about how drugs, that are given to children by their health care provider, act in the bodies of children and young adults in hopes to find the most safe and effective dose for children. The primary objective of this study is to evaluate the PK of understudied drugs currently being administered to children per SOC as prescribed by their treating provider.

relevance.reasoning: 低度相關——多藥物 PK/PD 安全性研究，Azithromycin 可能為研究藥物之一，但非針對先天性血液疾病的療效研究。可提供 PK 資料作為劑量設計參考。

literature.title: Antibiotics for preventing lower respiratory tract infections in high-risk children aged 12 years and under.
literature.journal: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
literature.abstract: Lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs) in young children account for 1.4 million deaths annually worldwide. repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 主要聚焦於鐮刀型紅血球病（Sickle Cell Disease, SCD）：Azithromycin 的免疫調節與抗炎機轉可能降低急性胸症（Acute Chest Syndrome, ACS）的發生率，此為 SCD 最嚴重的肺部併發症。此外，巨環類抗生素可改善氣道炎症（如囊狀纖維化中的證據），類似機轉可能適用於 SCD 患者的肺功能改善（FEV1）。兩項已規劃的 Phase 1/2 試驗（NCT02630394、NCT02960503）均因故撤回（enrolled = 0），顯示學術界有研究意圖但尚無執行資料。
